citations.quote:
[name="Raidian"]我已经静默周围可视范围内所有通讯，直接动手。
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_boneflute",volume=1)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4133_logos_1#3$1")]
[name="Logos"]（吹响骨哨）
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_521_1#1$1")]
[name="Mechanist"]哼，他们的武器能克制我的设备，却对你的骨哨和咒言没有太多抵抗能力。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4133_logos_1#1$1")]
[name="Logos"]并非如此，他们只是尚不甚了解我的言语规则罢了。
[name="Logos"]我对阿戈尔创造如此精妙武器的思路亦有好奇。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_521_1#1$1")]
[name="Mechanist"]那我收缴一点回去拆了帮你研究研究。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1730_1#2$1")]
[name="Raidian"]你们两个！我们还在执行任务呢！
[name="Raidian"]前面还有至少三支队伍在埋伏，我们分身乏术。
[name="Raidian"]恐怕没法暗中干净处理完了，必须得通知我们的人准备应对冲击——
[dialog]
[charslot]
[playsound(key="$transmission")]
[interlude(maskid = "group_interclude_vertical_common" ,size = "290,760", style=0 ,switch = true, offset = "250,0", channel = 1,tsfrom = "0,1", tsto="1,1",tsduration = 0.5)]
[interlude(channel = 1, type = 3, slot = "m", switch = true, pfrom = "255,0", pto="255,0", name = "avg_391_rosmon_1#1$1", duration = 0.5)]
[interlude(channel = 1, type = 2, slot = "r", switch = true,name = "bg_aircraft", duration = 0)]
[interlude(maskid = "group_interclude_vertical_common" ,size = "290,760",tsfrom="0,1", tsto ="1,1",tsduration = 0.5, switch = true, style = 0,offset = "-250,0", channel = 2)]
[interlude(channel = 2, switch = true, type = 3, slot = "m", pfrom = "-250,0", pto="-250,0", name = "avg_017_huang_1#1$1", duration = 0.5)]
[interlude(channel = 2, type = 2, slot = "r", switch = true,name = "bg_aircraft", duration = 0)]
[delay(time=1.5)]
[interlude(channel = 1, type = 3, slot = "m", switch = false)]
[name="煌"]喂喂喂，博士快递的支援就位了！
[name="煌"]Raidian，Mechanist，替我们标记位置，“坏家伙”号马上赶过去！
[interlude(channel = 2, type = 3, slot = "m", switch = false)]
[charslot(slot="m",focus="n")]
[name="Mechanist"]煌？！
[name="Mechanist"]查看你们的通讯设备，我已经把位置同步给了你们。
[interlude(channel = 2, type = 3, slot = "m", switch = true)]
[name="煌"]收到——
[interlude(channel = 2, switch = true, type = 3,  name = "avg_017_huang_1#8$1", pfrom = "-250,0", pto="-250,0")]
[name="煌"]等等，迷迭香，不是说好我先跳替你吸引火力吗？！
[interlude(channel = 2, type = 3, slot = "m", switch = false)]
[interlude(channel = 1, type = 3, slot = "m", switch = true)]
[name="迷迭香"]我会控制好法术。
[playsound(key="$d_gen_transmissionget")]
[interlude(channel = 1, clear = true,tsduration = 0.5,tsfrom = "1,1", tsto="0,1")]
[interlude(channel = 2, clear = true,tsduration = 0.5,tsfrom = "1,1", tsto="0,1")]
[Dialog]
[Delay(time=1)]
[playsound(key="$d_avg_rosoutofcontrol", loop=true, channel="m",volume=0)]
[SoundVolume(volume=0.5, channel="m",fadetime=2)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=2, block=true)]
[charslot]
[Delay(time=2)]
[StopSound(channel="m", fadetime=2)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=2, block=true)]
[Delay(time=0.5)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_391_rosmon_1#1$1")]
[name="迷迭香"]结束了？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1730_1#1$1")]
[name="Raidian"]我检查了周边区域的所有信号，的确已经全部清除了。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_017_huang_1#7$1")]
[name="煌"]呃，谁能告诉我……这到底是个啥玩意儿？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1401_1#1$1",focus="n")]
[name="损坏的“小帮手”"]……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_017_huang_1#1$1")]
[name="煌"]我在这东西试图自毁的时候，可花了全力砸它才把它停下来。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_391_rosmon_1#10$1")]
[name="迷迭香"]和我们对接的也是阿戈尔，他们为什么要袭击我们的人员和设备？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_521_1#1$1")]
[name="Mechanist"]交给凯尔希医生和博士判断。
[name="Mechanist"]确保人员和设备安全交接到克莱门莎的人手中后，我们立刻返回本舰。
[name="Mechanist"]这些情况必须尽快处理。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4133_logos_1#6$1")]
[name="Logos"]还有未知的泄密者，恐怕这只是开端。

contributions.description: Mechanist明确知道克莱门莎及其交接人员。
